metadata.description: Official Nimble plugin: web data toolkit and business workflow skills

plugins.name: nimble
plugins.description: Real-time web search and data extraction for AI agents - powered by Nimble. Search, extract, map, and crawl any site on the web with built-in stealth, JS rendering, and retries. Get clean, structured web data from any public webpage with site-specific Extraction Templates, or run Web Search Agents for open-ended research and enrichment. The definitive web data toolkit for AI-native development.
